verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments and fintech platform, so the axis applies. The pack does not document any full-account data export in open formats or any offboarding path. The only related item is the CLI's ability to operate 'reports' (docs-27), which is an adjacent feature and not a documented complete export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
